nodes.title: Note+
widgets_values:
### LTX-2 Native Resolutions

Keep values divisible by 32 to ensure compatibility. Here are examples you can use:

- Standard Landscape (16:9)

	- 832 x 480 (480p)
	- 960 x 520 (540p)
    - 1280 x 704 (720p optimized)
    - 1920 x 1088 (Native 1080p)
    - 2560 x 1440 (2K - High VRAM)

- Portrait / Social (9:16)

    - 704 x 1280 (Standard Vertical)
    - 1088 x 1920 (High Res Vertical)
	
- Cinematic Widescreen (2.39:1)

    - 1536 x 640 (Efficient Wide)
    - 1920 x 800 (Full Wide)

- Square (1:1)

    - 768 x 768 (Fast)
    - 1024 x 1024 (Standard)

widgets_values:
Set "Resize by Longer Edge" for the size of the longer side of your image.

The resolution will automaticaly resize the image while keeping the same proportions. 

Values are divisible by 32 to ensure compatibility.
